tools.description: Applies nonlinear shaping at each recursive phase-modulation level, with smooth and raw comparison modes.
tools.start: Turn on audio, then play a MIDI or computer key and compare smooth and raw modes.

tools.label: Cascading FM
tools.description: Chains sine oscillators across rising, equal, or falling base frequencies, each one frequency-modulating the next with tapered depth.
tools.start: Turn on audio, then adjust the stage count, cascade ratio, modulation depth, and depth taper.

tools.label: Cascading PM
tools.description: Chains sine operators across rising, equal, or falling base frequencies, with every stage offsetting the next stage's phase in radians.
tools.start: Turn on audio, then adjust the stage count, cascade ratio, phase index, and index taper.

tools.label: Weierstrass
tools.description: Sums exponentially spaced oscillators as a waveform or uses the same fractal bank for FM and phase modulation.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose Wave, FM, or Phase, then adjust the oscillator bank.

tools.label: Fabric Filter
tools.description: Sends correlated colored noise through interacting two-dimensional wave fields, a Shepard-wrapped Q/FFT lattice, and a visible damped mass-spring frequency fabric shaped by direct grabs and user-triggered propagation.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a preset and sculptor, then grab or pluck the fabric. There are no hidden audio-only LFOs, drifts, motors, or automatic plucks: the direct grab override ends on release, and only visibly moving fabric and user-triggered waves continue moving the spectral controls while normal audio tails decay.

tools.label: Playhead Paint
tools.description: Turns freehand pointer strokes into playable sound gestures, mapping position, color, and pen size to pitch and timbre while mirrored axes create polyphonic reflections.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose X and Y mappings and a pen, then draw; release to end the note or loop the recorded path.

tools.label: Boidzoid
tools.description: Makes autonomous arrow playheads into continuous sine voices: height sweeps frequency without note divisions, horizontal position sets stereo, and speed breathes the level.
tools.start: Turn on audio, let the arrows drift, then drag the open surface to steer the sine field.

tools.label: Puggler the Punk Rock Jugger
tools.description: Turns up to ten objects into a thrashing punk band at up to 1,200 beats/minute. Puggler, Roxy, and Moss pass props, catch audience lobs, and throw them back; catches strike recorded drums and airborne paths bend riffs on a filthy punk stage.
tools.start: Enable Audio. Fixed clickable keys control each rider: WASD for Puggler, IJKL for Roxy, numpad for Moss. Drag anyone. Pause holds new juggling throws while riders and the crowd stay active.

tools.label: Vector Flight
tools.description: Keeps a wireframe ship centered inside a full 360-degree star field, mapping a circular listening contour, azimuth, proximity, radial velocity, and tangential motion directly into continuous voices, free-pitch flybys, or triggers without a scale grid.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose Continuous, Notes, or Triggers, drag around the ship to rotate the physics mapping, then raise the throttle until points become hyperspace rays and full-circle plaid.

tools.label: Gesturama
tools.description: Turns live motion into painted drums, continuously shaped resonant pads, recorded microphone samples, or a Karplus–Strong video harp.
tools.start: Start the camera, choose a preset, then move through the grid or strings; use the pointer only to paint new sound zones.

tools.label: Wheel of Organs
tools.description: Grows every typed letter into its own morphable glottal mouth on a quiet one-shot wheel, sounding wet nasal and slime cavities only when each organ crosses the fixed three-o'clock reader.
tools.start: Turn on audio, set the letter wheel, and spin; it accelerates, coasts, and brakes before the final organ sustains and fades, then unlocks for another spin.

tools.label: Feral Fairy Ferris Ferry
tools.description: Carries an audible Level 1 contour through nested moving shapes whose inherited positions control pitch, amplitude modulation, delay time, and feedback.
tools.start: Turn on audio, start the Ferris transport, then assign shapes and Pass, Modulator, or Delay processing to the higher levels.

tools.label: FM Drums
tools.description: Edits the sixteen-voice FM and shaped-noise percussion bank used by the drum machines.
tools.start: Turn on audio or MIDI, hit a pad, then edit and save its synthesized voice.

tools.label: Rattlesnake
tools.description: Maps frequency onto one continuous body with four Rattlesnake models plus a Karplus Strong model whose four complete presets morph across the snake.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a sound model, then drag across the spectrum or silently reposition its dotted morph boundaries.

tools.label: Karplus Strong
tools.description: Plucks noise or impulse excitation into a tunable feedback-delay model with spectral loss, polarity, nonlinearity, modulation, pickup, body, and sympathetic-string controls.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a string or preset, then click or drag across the stage to pluck and strum.

tools.label: Karplus Carpet
tools.description: Turns a dense two-dimensional surface of close areas into freshly synthesized Karplus attacks with adjustable one-shot amplitude ADSR, two sound-variety banks, deterministic cell color, and coupled resonators across a tunable microtonal pitch field, without loading sample grains.
tools.start: Press and drag across the surface: each newly crossed area sounds once per gesture, while moving inside an area or holding still stays silent.

tools.label: Surround for Safety
tools.description: Places synth or imported audio inside 7:4:1, 4:1, eight-speaker circle, eight-speaker cube, and two-to-thirty-two-channel custom arrays, with calibrated speaker tests and synchronized channel-stem capture.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose an array, then test a numbered speaker, move the coral source, load an audio file, or record the virtual outputs as mono WAV stems.

tools.label: Sample Drums
tools.description: Edits a sixteen-slot 808/909-style sample bank that can also replace the Lattice Drum Machine synth bank.
tools.start: Turn on audio or MIDI, hit a pad, then load or trim samples in the selected slot.

tools.label: Dentaphone
tools.description: Turns 32 individually playable upper and lower teeth into a two-layer dental marimba driven by a sample-free AudioWorklet physical model, editable damped modes, spatial excitation, and modal JSON exchange.
tools.start: Turn on audio and tap, drag, brush, or chomp the teeth; choose a pitch distribution, then reshape the shared wood, glass, steel, ceramic, bronze, or imported modal body.

tools.label: Automatapoeia
tools.description: Shows exact, live-switchable binary evolution across all 256 elementary rules and 64 radius-2 totalistic codes, with explicit boundaries and measurable shape contours.
tools.start: Change family, rule or code, and boundary without restarting, then sculpt the next rows through finite mono physical, FM/PM, additive, wavefold, or resonant-air voices with swing and ADSR.

tools.label: Sorting
tools.description: Runs five sorting algorithms on the same shuffle and maps comparisons, swaps, and writes to sound.
tools.start: Choose an algorithm, randomize the values, then press Play to hear each operation.

tools.label: DJ Dijkstra
tools.description: Spreads a weighted search frontier across a grid and maps node distance, weight, and position into a spatial path score.
tools.start: Turn on audio, rewire the graph, then play or scrub the frontier.

tools.label: Wave Pool
tools.description: Couples piston paddles or pneumatic caissons to a slow gravity-wave clock, then makes breaking spray, entrained bubbles, wet boundary slaps, structural modes, and aerated whirlpools into four interlocking sample-free rhythm lanes.
tools.start: Turn on audio, run the four-lane sequence, then tap the pool or use keys 1–4 while changing water depth, wave height, bubble radius, wall system, and receiver position.

tools.label: Penrose Tilings
tools.description: Moves five exact Penrose presentations behind one fixed reader: edge paths sustain sine voices, while new physical intersections trigger FM percussion.
tools.start: Choose a presentation and local window, then follow the visible signal net and next-edge targets as the tiling moves; angle shear keeps shared edges sealed while clearly leaving canonical geometry.

tools.label: Yoyodyne
tools.description: Sonifies one spinning yo-yo and its constrained string: length and tension bend pitch, travel shapes the voice, and four hand-driven routines trace distinct phrases.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a trick and Perform, or Throw once and drag the hand. Tug excites the string; Catch binds the yo-yo back to the performer.

tools.label: Hanoi Carillon
tools.description: Rings every legal Towers of Hanoi transfer as a metallic voice whose pitch follows disk size and pan follows the peg.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose the disk count, then play the recursive transfer sequence.

tools.label: Alpha-Beta Minimax
tools.description: Turns minimax evaluations into tense calls and answers while alpha-beta pruning cuts branches with percussive noise.
tools.start: Turn on audio, reseed the contest, then play or scrub the search tree.

tools.label: N-Queens Backtracker
tools.description: Builds harmony from valid queen placements, noise from conflicts, and falling gestures from backtracking.
tools.start: Turn on audio, shuffle the columns, then play the board search.

tools.label: Euclidean Pulse
tools.description: Turns Euclidean remainders into descending bass and each exact quotient into a repeated rhythmic pulse cell.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a new ratio, then play or scrub its division chain.

tools.label: Alien Larynx
tools.description: Keeps the recognizable Throatazoid voice beneath five optional systems for coupled folds, true-scale propagation, mouth genomes, robot glands, and wormhole routing.
tools.start: Start with every alien system bypassed, turn on audio, then bring the five mutations online one at a time or return instantly to the anchored voice.

tools.label: Hyper-Syrinx
tools.description: Multiplies breaths, membranes, labia, tracheas, tracts, mouths, and lips into a patchable polyphonic physical-voice laboratory.
tools.start: Turn on audio, duplicate or remove organ modules, choose how they share signals, then hold Breath while reshaping the combined voice.

tools.label: Morphynx
tools.description: Crossfades persistent Syrinx and larynx models while multiple physical voices, tongue constrictions, nasal resonances, microphone formants, and letter-key mutations reshape the tract.
tools.start: Choose an animal and voice, move the Syrinx–Larynx morph, then play a call or hold A–Z; add voices, tongues, or nasal cavities to hear the anatomy branch out.

tools.label: Escher
tools.description: Builds original procedural motifs on Euclidean wallpaper groups, similarity recursions, and exact Poincaré-disk reflection tilings whose rendered contours become the playhead paths.
tools.start: Tap a shape, then follow its literal outline, real shared-border neighbors, or matching pattern family; smaller measured contours naturally recur faster.

tools.label: Plasma Ball
tools.description: Fires quiet, intermittent synth-static through branching paths across the near and far surfaces of a three-dimensional glass globe.
tools.start: Turn on audio, then move or touch the glass to gather some discharges while the rest keep searching the globe.

tools.label: SIMD Resonator
tools.description: Turns one strike into a 128-mode resonant body whose material, position, hardness, tuning, decay, and inharmonic spread remain directly playable while WebAssembly SIMD accelerates the parallel modes.
tools.start: Turn on Audio, choose a material, then tap or drag the body. Microphone input can excite the same resonator.

tools.label: Order Tones
tools.description: Turns modular repetition and an inverse-QFT model into a probability comb used to estimate order and factors.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a preset, then run shots and listen to the probability peaks.

tools.label: Morphazoidical
tools.description: Shows the live form, contact, reader, and event data available for geometry-to-sound mappings.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a form and reader, then drag the stage and inspect its live values.

tools.label: Bell Square
tools.description: Simulates two atoms with a controlled collision phase and sonifies correlated measurements along chosen axes.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose measurement axes, then run repeated shots.

tools.label: Entanglement Dance
tools.description: Hears quantum entanglement as a slowed-down square dance — two qubits precess together or in opposition based on their Bell state.
tools.start: Turn on audio, press play, then try each Bell state and listen for correlated or anti-correlated melodic motion.

tools.label: Quantum Square Dance
tools.description: Runs an exact classical simulation of controlled spin exchange in paired atoms and sonifies the evolving joint state, phase, and correlations.
tools.start: Turn on audio, then play or scrub the exchange dance and compare its paired-atom scenes.

tools.label: Annealogue
tools.description: Moves eight three-qubit states through an anneal, mapping energy, probability, and phase to a cube and choir.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a problem preset, then run or scrub the anneal.

tools.label: Gravity Walk
tools.description: Moves a bead along a polygon, star, or circle and maps height, speed, and impacts to sound.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a path, then release the bead or change gravity.

tools.label: Ricochet
tools.description: Bounces balls through editable arenas where wall angle controls pitch and impact speed controls level.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose an arena, then launch balls and move its walls.

tools.label: Rigidity
tools.description: Loads pinned bar-and-joint structures under gravity to reveal which constraints hold, flex, or fail.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a structure, then apply load or move a joint.

tools.label: Rolling Measure
tools.description: Rolls regular polygons vertex to vertex while centroid lift, contact changes, and impact loss shape the sound.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a polygon, then start rolling and adjust the surface.

tools.label: Falling Forms
tools.description: Drops rigid forms into a stage and maps impacts, rotation, friction, and settling to sound.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a form, then drop copies into the stage.

tools.label: Charge Garden
tools.description: Combines positive and negative charges in a softened field with visible tracers and equipotential lines.
tools.start: Turn on audio, place or drag charges, then release tracers into the field.

tools.label: Packing Pressure
tools.description: Compresses falling disks into a contact network and maps force, density, coordination, and jams to sound.
tools.start: Turn on audio, add disks, then lower the press or change their packing.

tools.label: Geodesic Drift
tools.description: Compares nearby straightest paths on a plane, cylinder, sphere, and torus as their separation evolves.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a surface, then launch nearby paths and vary their starting angle.

tools.label: Kinetic Hull
tools.description: Recomputes a convex hull and Delaunay edges around moving points; boundary changes and edge flips trigger sound.
tools.start: Turn on audio, add or move points, then start their motion.

tools.label: RISSET-MOIRE
tools.description: Crosses rising and falling Shepard lattices so weighted line intersections emphasize audible coincidences.
tools.start: Turn on audio, start both layers, then change their angles and glissando rates.

tools.label: Chladni Plate
tools.description: Draws standing-wave nodal curves on a square plate and uses mode and strike position to shape its partials.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a plate mode, then click or drag a strike point.

tools.label: Spring Choir
tools.description: Simulates a coupled mass-spring chain and turns its normal modes into a quiet oscillator choir.
tools.start: Turn on audio, pull a mass, then release it and change the coupling.

tools.label: Gear Ratio Drums
tools.description: Rotates two meshed cogs at tooth-locked rates so contacts become a gear-ratio polyrhythm.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose tooth counts, then start the gears and change their speed.

tools.label: Prime Sieve
tools.description: Runs the sieve of Eratosthenes, turning prime discoveries into a rising melody and eliminations into ticks.
tools.start: Turn on audio, reset the grid, then run or step through the sieve.

tools.label: Lissajous Orbits
tools.description: Uses one integer ratio for both a closed Lissajous curve and its two-oscillator musical interval.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose an axis ratio, then change phase and speed.

tools.label: Pendulum Wave
tools.description: Sets neighboring pendulums to related periods so they drift apart, form waves, and reunite.
tools.start: Turn on audio, release the pendulums, then change their count or period spread.

tools.label: Double Pendulum
tools.description: Releases two nearly identical double pendulums and widens an interval as their chaotic paths diverge.
tools.start: Turn on audio, set a small starting difference, then release both pendulums.

tools.label: Reaction-Diffusion
tools.description: Evolves a Gray-Scott chemical field through spots, bands, and splits that control a small sound field.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a reaction preset, then seed or paint the field.

tools.label: Atomic Orbitals
tools.description: Draws signed planar slices of hydrogen orbitals and maps quantum numbers and nodes to a harmonic bank.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose quantum numbers, then move through the orbital slice.

tools.label: DNA Translator
tools.description: Scans editable DNA through four base pitches and adds a tone for each completed amino-acid codon.
tools.start: Turn on audio, edit or randomize the strand, then start the scanner.

tools.label: Neural Pulse
tools.description: Sends four inputs through a fixed weighted network and triggers sound as activity crosses each layer.
tools.start: Turn on audio, change the four inputs, then send a pulse through the network.

tools.label: Fourier Epicycles
tools.description: Chains rotating harmonic vectors into classic waveforms, with every visible vector acting as an audible partial.
tools.start: Turn on audio, choose a waveform, then change the number of epicycles.

tools.label: Gravity Lens
tools.description: Uses an idealized gravitational lens to split one source into two apparent images and a paired interval.
tools.start: Turn on audio, move the source or lens, then compare image position, level, and delay.

tools.label: Cantor Lock
tools.description: Searches for a finite signal inside matching Cantor-shaped position and frequency masks, mapping addresses to pitch and pulse while retained energy and leakage divide a glass-and-amber ensemble.
tools.start: Turn on audio, compare an interval with Cantor masks, then tighten the trap and listen to retained energy separate from leakage.

tools.label: Escape Dust
tools.description: Compares classical survivors with a leaking finite wave in an open triadic baker map: phase-space position writes melody and pan, survival orchestrates the chord, and escape flux strikes its accents.
tools.start: Turn on audio, release a packet, then step or play the map while escaped points and wave energy enter the flux monitor.

tools.label: Linebreaker
tools.description: Probes crossed lines, a Sierpiński carpet, and Cantor dust while occupied runs sustain organ rails, gaps fracture the phrase, and two-dimensional Fourier peaks orchestrate the harmony.
tools.start: Turn on audio, rotate the line probe across each structure, then compare its sampled gaps with the two-dimensional Fourier pattern.

tools.label: Tempo Tantrum
tools.description: Three continuously evolving phase oscillators lock to a driving pulse, slip outside the locking range, and recover after a nudge; their own crossings trigger the notes.
tools.start: Enable Audio and Play, then nudge a bead or drag it outward to detune it. Compare strong coupling with a released drive.

tools.label: Tape Worm
tools.description: One playback head crosses between two intact recordings at movable splices, with file and microphone capture, varispeed, and a bypass for original loops.
tools.start: Enable Audio and Play to hear the demo, then drag a splice or click a tape to reposition the reader. Recording replaces only the selected tape.

tools.label: Loop Soup
tools.description: Three persistent loops mix stored audio, a local demo ingredient, or microphone input with bounded spill between bowls, exact hold, overdubbing, and selective erasure.
tools.start: Enable Audio and Play, select a bowl, and compare Hold with Overdub. Turn on the erase brush to remove sound from a region of tape.

tools.label: Habit Habitat
tools.description: Manual node visits teach a bounded transition network; seeded weighted recall plays those tendencies without reinforcing its own playback.
tools.start: Enable Audio, choose Teach, and tap numbered nodes. Switch to Recall and Play to hear the learned routes; save a memory in this browser.

tools.label: Hollowphonic
tools.description: Three damped, coupled delay-line resonators reshape noise, a drone, or microphone input; dragging cavity depth retunes resonances and direct strikes excite the same chambers.
tools.start: Enable Audio and Play, drag a chamber deeper, or strike it directly. Compare bypass and damping while the source remains unchanged.
